sample_data.method: Bundled organizer fixture plus in-browser JSON file upload using the published schema 2.2 shape
sample_data.reset_instructions: Select Reset in the header to restore the bundled 25-case fixture and PUB-01.

problem_solving_method: A pure TypeScript engine evaluates subject component passes, grade bands, optional bonus, compulsory-fail override, final GPA and checking flags. The Next.js interface derives the register, per-student audit trace and three non-exclusive checking queues from the same evaluated result objects. Boundary, overlap, upload and all-public-fixture behavior is automated-tested.

R1.evidence: /dashboard metrics and charts; /results register; shared case selector and upload/reset controls; src/data/P08_school_results_public.json; src/data/fixture.ts

R2.evidence: /results sortable and searchable register; src/domain/engine.ts; src/domain/engine.test.ts

R3.evidence: Select Trace from /results or /checks; components/student-trace.tsx shows every mark, grade point, decision rule, GPA formula, uncancelled GPA and compulsory-fail override

R4.evidence: /checks three tabbed tables; src/domain/engine.ts buildCheckingLists; overlap test in src/domain/engine.test.ts

team_members.major_contribution: Sole participant: domain modeling, fixture integration, result engine, tests, Next.js/shadcn interface, accessibility, documentation and verification.

major_design_decisions: Evaluate every rule in a pure domain module independent of React so the official edge cases are directly testable.
Check theory and practical component passes before grade-band lookup, preventing a high total from masking a component failure.
Preserve the uncancelled GPA and exact failing-subject decisions when the compulsory-fail override publishes 0.00/F.
Derive all three non-exclusive teacher queues from the same evaluated result model used by the register and trace.
Bundle the organizer fixture and validate judge-supplied JSON locally so evaluation requires no secret or external service.
known_limitations: The evaluator accepts complete fixture JSON rather than supporting per-mark editing.
Uploaded fixture state and filters reset on page refresh.
Fixture, selected case and table filter state reset on a browser refresh.

ai_tools_used.used_for: Implementation assistance, test drafting, interface composition and documentation.
ai_tools_used.how_output_was_verified: Checked against the official clarifications with 35 automated tests, all 25 public cases, TypeScript, ESLint, a production Next.js build and browser QA.
